l4_steps.name: Extract booking & no-show history from PSS
l4_steps.input: Departed flight records, booking logs, check-in data — rolling 24 months
l4_steps.output: Raw no-show and cancellation dataset by flight, fare class, and booking channel
l4_steps.pain_point: Altéa PSS history exports require manual scheduling; ad-hoc pulls risk data truncation beyond 13-month rolling window

l4_steps.name: Segment data by route, DOW, fare class, season
l4_steps.input: Raw no-show dataset from Altéa PSS export
l4_steps.output: Segmented no-show rate matrix with confidence intervals per cluster
l4_steps.kpi: Minimum 90 observed flights per segment for statistical significance
l4_steps.pain_point: Thin markets (<5 flights/week) produce unreliable segment-level no-show rates; pooled estimates inflate overbooking risk

l4_steps.name: Run no-show forecast model and validate accuracy
l4_steps.input: Segmented no-show matrix, demand forecasts from AltéaRM
l4_steps.output: No-show show-up curve per flight cluster; model accuracy report
l4_steps.kpi: Forecast vs. actual no-show rate MAPE ≤5%
l4_steps.pain_point: NRM show-up model requires retraining after major schedule restructures; post-COVID demand patterns invalidated legacy curves for 18+ months

l4_steps.name: Calibrate show-up curve by fare class and lead time
l4_steps.input: Validated no-show forecast model; approved show-up curves
l4_steps.output: Calibrated show-up probability curves published to AltéaRM overbooking module
l4_steps.kpi: Show-up curve refresh cycle ≤30 days for high-frequency routes; ≤90 days for seasonal routes
l4_steps.pain_point: Fare class proliferation (Basic Economy vs. flexible fares) requires separate show-up curves; legacy model treats all economy as one class

l4_steps.name: Generate recommended OB factors by flight segment
l4_steps.input: Calibrated show-up curves; target load factor ≥83%; denied boarding cost assumptions
l4_steps.output: Recommended overbooking factor per flight segment with expected IDB rate
l4_steps.kpi: Expected IDB rate ≤0.05 per 10,000 enplaned passengers (DOT Part 250 benchmark)
l4_steps.pain_point: NRM OB optimiser does not natively model denied boarding compensation cost per DOT 14 CFR 250 tiers; analyst must manually adjust factors to avoid regulatory overshoot

l4_steps.name: Apply DOT 14 CFR 250 regulatory cap and fare rule check
l4_steps.input: Recommended OB factors; ATPCO fare conditions (refundability, cancellation fees)
l4_steps.output: Compliance-reviewed OB factor set; flag for non-refundable fare interactions
l4_steps.kpi: 100% of OB factors within DOT involuntary bump compensation trigger thresholds
l4_steps.pain_point: Non-refundable Basic Economy fares have near-zero pre-departure cancellations, artificially inflating apparent show-up rates; ATPCO Rule 35 interactions must be hand-checked

l4_steps.name: Approve and publish booking limits to PSS inventory
l4_steps.input: Compliance-reviewed OB factor set; Director sign-off
l4_steps.output: Authorised overbooking limits loaded into Altéa inventory control per flight
l4_steps.kpi: Limit publication latency ≤4 hours ahead of booking horizon open; 100% of flights have an active OB limit
l4_steps.pain_point: Altéa inventory control updates via batch file load — real-time limit changes mid-booking horizon require manual override in Altéa Inventory module, increasing error risk

l4_steps.name: Monitor booking pace vs. authorised OB limits
l4_steps.input: Live booking feed from Altéa PSS; authorised OB limits
l4_steps.output: Booking pace dashboard with oversale risk flags per flight
l4_steps.kpi: Alert response time ≤15 minutes of threshold breach detection
l4_steps.pain_point: NRM booking pace alerts are polled every 30 minutes; fast-filling charter diversions or flash sales can exceed limits before alerts trigger

l4_steps.name: Detect and triage oversale threshold breach
l4_steps.input: Booking pace alert; current bookings vs. authorised limit
l4_steps.output: Oversale risk classification (low / medium / high) with recommended action
l4_steps.kpi: False positive rate ≤10% of alerts triaged as high-risk
l4_steps.pain_point: Group booking blocks held in Altéa GRP segment are excluded from NRM oversale count until confirmed, masking true capacity exposure up to T-72h

l4_steps.name: Adjust OB level or close booking class dynamically
l4_steps.input: Oversale risk classification; updated show-up probability at current booking depth
l4_steps.output: Revised OB factor or booking class closure instruction applied to Altéa PSS
l4_steps.kpi: OB adjustment applied within 30 minutes of triage decision; no flight departs with OB factor >20% above baseline
l4_steps.pain_point: Closing discount booking classes to reduce oversale pressure destroys revenue on price-sensitive leisure itineraries; analyst must balance IDB risk vs. yield impact

l4_steps.name: Escalate high-risk oversale flights to RM Supervisor
l4_steps.input: High-risk oversale flag; passenger manifest; connecting itinerary exposure
l4_steps.output: Escalation note with recommended corrective action; decision to hold or reduce OB
l4_steps.kpi: Escalation-to-decision cycle time ≤1 hour; 100% of high-risk flights reviewed by T-24h
l4_steps.pain_point: Connecting passengers on interline itineraries (not native Altéa bookings) are not surfaced in NRM oversale count; last-minute IDB on these passengers triggers DOT reporting obligation

l4_steps.name: Identify oversold flights at check-in closure
l4_steps.input: Final check-in count; boarded passenger list; aircraft capacity
l4_steps.output: Confirmed oversale count and list of checked-in passengers eligible for VDB/IDB
l4_steps.kpi: Oversold flight identification completed ≥30 minutes before departure
l4_steps.pain_point: SITA AMS and Altéa DCS (Departure Control System) seat count reconciliation can diverge by 1-2 seats when upgrade or UMNR seat blocks are reassigned at gate

l4_steps.name: Solicit and screen volunteers for VDB compensation
l4_steps.input: Oversold count; gate board call; compensation parameters from RM Supervisor
l4_steps.output: Confirmed volunteer list with accepted compensation; rebooked itineraries in Altéa
l4_steps.kpi: VDB rate ≥80% of oversale situations resolved without IDB; average VDB compensation cost ≤$350
l4_steps.pain_point: Compensation authority is set centrally by RM; gate agents cannot negotiate above the pre-approved cap without supervisor override, slowing volunteer acquisition on high-demand flights

l4_steps.name: Process involuntary denied boarding per 14 CFR 250
l4_steps.input: Confirmed oversale after VDB exhaustion; passenger priority matrix (status, fare, check-in time)
l4_steps.output: IDB passenger list; denied boarding compensation (cash/voucher at DOT-mandated 400% of OW fare, max $1,550)
l4_steps.kpi: IDB processing completed ≥15 minutes before door close; 0 IDB passengers with connecting flights missed due to rebooking delay
l4_steps.pain_point: DOT priority boarding rules (status, early check-in) conflict with RM desire to protect high-yield last-minute fares; applying the correct matrix under gate pressure is error-prone

l4_steps.name: Issue compensation and confirm rebooking for IDB/VDB pax
l4_steps.input: IDB/VDB passenger list; approved compensation values; next available flight inventory
l4_steps.output: Compensation vouchers/cash issued; confirmed rebooking on next available service; IDB event logged
l4_steps.kpi: 100% of IDB passengers offered confirmed rebooking within 2 hours; compensation issued at gate before passenger departs
l4_steps.pain_point: Electronic voucher issuance via Altéa is not integrated with the passenger's Rapid Rewards account; compensation is issued as a separate code, creating friction and loyalty defection risk

l4_steps.name: Compile post-flight IDB/VDB statistics and cost data
l4_steps.input: Altéa IDB/VDB event logs; gate agent reports; compensation cost records
l4_steps.output: IDB/VDB summary report: count, cost, route, fare class, DOW breakdown
l4_steps.kpi: Report generated within 48 hours of flight departure; 100% event capture rate
l4_steps.pain_point: Gate agent IDB logs in Altéa DCS are free-text fields; structured data extraction requires ETL cleanup before Redshift load, delaying post-flight analytics by up to 5 days

l4_steps.name: Review denied boarding KPIs against policy thresholds
l4_steps.input: IDB/VDB summary report; rolling 12-month trend; DOT Part 250 benchmark (0.05 IDB per 10k pax)
l4_steps.output: KPI review decision: policy adequate or recalibration required
l4_steps.kpi: IDB rate ≤0.05 per 10,000 enplaned passengers; VDB cost ≤$350 average per event
l4_steps.pain_point: Seasonal spikes (holiday periods, irregular operations) mask underlying OB model drift; point-in-time KPI review may miss structural deterioration in show-up accuracy

l4_steps.name: Submit DOT quarterly denied boarding compliance report
l4_steps.system: DOT Air Travel Consumer Report Submission Portal
l4_steps.input: Validated IDB/VDB statistics; carrier passenger enplanement totals
l4_steps.output: Filed DOT Part 250 quarterly report; internal compliance archive record
l4_steps.kpi: 100% on-time filing by DOT deadline (30 days after quarter end); zero restatements
l4_steps.pain_point: DOT requires IDB figures disaggregated by aircraft size categories; Altéa fleet-type tagging must be manually reconciled against FAA registration data to ensure accurate segment classification
